about_the_game:
A mascot horror game where you use a rubber chicken as a flashlight, modifying it with various energies to solve puzzles. Restore the electricity, explore Sunshine Farms, and be careful not to make loud noises. If Squawky sees or hears you, it will chase you, so if that happens, RUN FOR YOUR LIFE!

ANNA (Player Character)

You’re a 9-year-old child who gets lost in a cornfield and ends up at the residence of the owners of Sunshine Farm.

SUNSHINE FARMS

Sunshine Farms is going out of business. They were known for hosting pumpkin patch events, growing corn, and manufacturing rubber Squawky chicken toys. They also created the "Squawk-O-Matic" machine, which can modify your rubber chicken toy by adding various energies such as light, fire, water, electricity, and earth.

SQUAWKY

Squawky is a lab experiment gone wrong. Its creators took advantage of the failed experiment and began profiting from people's curiosity to see Squawky. As a result, Squawky became increasingly hostile toward people and ultimately caused Sunshine Farms to go bankrupt. It is also highly sensitive to loud noises. DON’T GET CAUGHT BY SQUAWKY.

RUBBER CHICKEN TOY

Your rubber chicken lights up when squeezed, but it makes a loud noise that will prompt Squawky to come and investigate. SQUEEZE AT YOUR OWN RISK!

Modify your rubber chicken with different energies by using the "Squawk-O-Matic" machine.

BRING ELECTRICITY BACK TO THE FARM

Your goal is to restore electricity to the farm so you can power up the "Squawk-O-Genesis" machine, eliminate Squawky, and escape.
